title: Multi-Target Blend Property Prediction Pipeline
summary: A machine learning pipeline built for the Shell.AI Hackathon that predicts 10 blend properties from component compositions using TabPFN, gradient boosting, deep learning, and AutoML approaches. Its data ingestion module optionally uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on a SingleTableMetadata schema, to generate synthetic training rows for augmentation.
